items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: Bucks Cottrell was Arthur's buddy and friend, so he rode with his little bit of Arthur during the, in a mile of T-fold.

ctx.x: When you feel the instrument, when you pick up the instrument, you feel it, you know, you have a tendency to play it differently, you know.
Well, the reason I was thinking about that, because it struck me in listening to Cottrell's playing, that when he played tenor, it was much like his clarinet.
Well, some of the things you do, you know.
